summary: MPLX LP filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to file exhibits related to a debt offering: an underwriting agreement dated August 10, 2026, supplemental indentures, and a legal opinion. The offering comprises $1.25 billion of 4.700% senior notes due 2029, $500 million of 5.000% senior notes due 2032, and $500 million of 5.500% senior notes due 2036, underwritten by TD Securities, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, SMBC Nikko, and Wells Fargo. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
